howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把数学模型的思路写成 Python 或 MATLAB 代码，运行并输出表格、图片和复现清单。
howto.when: 当你需要将数学建模方案变成可运行的代码，或要求输出结果表格、可视化图表时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Python 实现这个线性规划模型，并输出结果表格。
say.note: Claude 会写代码、运行并生成表格。

say.text: 把刚才的模型用 MATLAB 画出来，要三张候选图。
say.note: Claude 会生成三类可视化图。

say.text: 检查当前项目的依赖环境是否完整。
say.note: Claude 会运行环境检查脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you write Python or MATLAB code for mathematical models, run it, and output tables, figures, and a reproducibility manifest.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to turn a mathematical modeling plan into runnable code, or request result tables, visualizations, or a reproducibility checklist.

say_en.text: Implement this linear programming model in Python and output the result table.
say_en.note: Claude will write code, run it, and generate a table.

say_en.text: Plot the model using MATLAB with three candidate figures.
say_en.note: Claude will generate three types of visualizations.

say_en.text: Check the dependency environment for the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will run the environment check script.
